g.text: Z2's KeepCrossAttention keeps A here, for the prompt's entry of the batch only:
the mean over the 20 heads gives 1024 × 77;
it keeps 4 columns: eagle (slot 2), fox (slot 5), end (slot 6), mean of padding (slots 7 to 76);
each column is a 32 × 32 map, upscaled to 128 × 128 and summed over 70 layers.
The sampler's own call computes the same A inside one fused kernel and never stores it;
that is why Z2 makes one extra call with this keeping processor.

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 14.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #1b2430

g.text: One transformer block at 32 × 32: patches ask patches, then ask the words, then each patch is reworked alone; Z2 reads the middle step

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #1b2430

g.text: 60 blocks like this one sit at 1280 channels on the 32 × 32 grid (down 2, middle, up 0); 10 more sit at 640 channels on 64 × 64 (down 1, up 1), drawn in journey 02. Each + circle adds a step's input back to its output.
